about_page.title: About Us - Elvosolar
about_page.hero_title: We open the doors to renewable and optimized energy.
about_page.content_title: Since our founding in 2009, we have built and successfully connected 32 photovoltaic power plants to the distribution grid. We currently ensure operation and comprehensive service for 38 power plants with a total installed capacity of up to 40 MWp, while also realizing further new builds of grid-connected, hybrid and off-grid photovoltaic power plants — from units of kilowatts to tens of megawatts. This ranks us among the most competent companies in the field of photovoltaic power plant realization and management, with a significant share of the regional market.
about_page.content_p1: Within innovation and the sustainability of our planet, we develop across the region the optimization of energy consumption and the generation of energy from renewable and waste sources. We combine the latest approaches to energy consumption optimization with energy-performance audit technologies. Practical, many years of experience from analyses, design, construction and management of energy-consumption optimization and renewable energy source equipment guarantees you the delivery of a quality solution with a professional approach before, during and after its installation, with a guarantee of reliable and economical operation.
about_page.content_p2: Our key customers come from both the private and public sectors, where we offer — beyond the implemented measures — cost-saving steps, remote device management, comprehensive energy audit services and tailored project documentation preparation, comprehensive energy project realization, construction and service of operations and equipment, and monitoring and maintenance of energy equipment.
about_page.partners_subtitle: We collaborate with leaders in energy, technology and sustainable development.
